column1: # DelosDB engine system properties: every delosdb.* name the engine reads.
# Checked by delosRepositoryIntegrityStaticAnalysis: the engine may read only names listed here,
# every name listed must still be read, and every proof must be a registered test.
# Profiles built from these classes are described in docs/MVCC-PROFILES.md.
#   SUPPORTED_DEFAULT  on in every supported profile; changing it is unsupported
#   SUPPORTED_SETTING  may be changed in a supported profile
#   EXPERIMENT         off by default and unsupported in any combination
#   DIAGNOSTIC         observation only; off by default
#   TEST_HOOK          used by tests to inject faults
#   INTERNAL           written and read by the engine itself
